description.en:
Adam SP is a PNDbotics humanoid platform for developing whole-body control and embodied-intelligence applications. The Adam architecture combines a human-like joint arrangement, force-controlled lower-body actuation and a dedicated control system. PNDbotics identifies an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB module as the AI computing platform for the Standard/SP configuration.

The official development tools include Python and ROS 2 interfaces, robot-specific simulation configurations and MuJoCo examples. These resources let developers test control policies before physical deployment. Adam SP is a distinct configuration within the Adam family, so interfaces and joint definitions should be matched to that model.
